response.rationale: DLE best fits the atrophic, scar-like facial lesions with lymphocytic infiltrate and dermal fibrosis; sarcoidosis lacks granulomas and follicular mucinosis lacks mucin/follicular changes.

rejected.why: No non-caseating granulomas or other systemic features to support sarcoidosis.
No mucin deposition or follicular involvement described; less specific for the clinical picture.
